projection: All 4219 source model keys, sorted; sample_spec excluded. Only flat standard input/output/cache-read/cache-creation per-token rates are projected. Missing cache rates remain omitted; existing estimator fallbacks apply. Provider, capability, modality, regional, context, batch, flex, priority and other source metadata/rates are not represented; consult pinned source for them.
